    Quick Start Guide - Aspose.Cells FOSS Documentation

    Generate API Documentation in 3 Steps

    Step 1: Build the Project

    cd E:\Aspose.Cells_Foss
dotnet build src/Aspose.Cells_FOSS/Aspose.Cells_FOSS.csproj

    Step 2: Generate Documentation

    cd documentation
dotnet run -- --metadata

    Step 3: View Documentation

    dotnet run -- --serve

    Then open http://localhost:8080 in your browser.

    Generate CHM Help File

    cd documentation
.\GenerateChm.ps1

    Requires HTML Help Workshop to be installed.

    What You Get

    • HTML Documentation: Professional API reference with navigation
    • CHM File: Standalone Windows help file
    • Search Functionality: Full-text search in CHM format
    • Examples: Code examples integrated with API documentation

    Troubleshooting

    "docfx not found"

    dotnet tool install -g docfx

    "XML documentation not found"

    Ensure the main project is built with the GenerateDocumentationFile property enabled (already configured in Aspose.Cells_FOSS.csproj).

    "HTML Help Workshop not found"

    Download from: https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/download/details.aspx?id=21138

    Customization

    • Edit index.md - Main landing page content
    • Edit toc.yml - Documentation structure and navigation
    • Add XML comments to source - API documentation content

    For More Information

    See README.md for detailed documentation.
